from pathlib import Path
path=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2d45495e.py')
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    patch = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    if not patch:
        return out
    pr0, pr1 = min(r for r, c in patch), max(r for r, c in patch)
    pc0, pc1 = min(c for r, c in patch), max(c for r, c in patch)
    colored = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 0)]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in colored), max(r for r, c in colored)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in colored), max(c for r, c in colored)
    for r in range(pr0, pr1 + 1):
        for c in range(pc0, pc1 + 1):
            source_r = sr0 + (r - pr0)
            source_c = sc1 - (c - pc0)
            out[r][c] = grid[source_r][source_c]
    return out
'''
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'), globals())
